dish.title: Roasted Cabbage Steaks with Cashew Romesco
dish.description: Thick cabbage steaks roasted in the oven until the cut faces are crisp, with a cashew romesco. Cashews only: no almonds and no dairy.

recipe_version.title: Roasted Cabbage Steaks with Cashew Romesco
recipe_version.description: Thick cabbage steaks roasted in the oven until the cut faces are crisp, with a cashew romesco. Cashews only: no almonds and no dairy.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp on the cabbage, 3 tbsp in the sauce

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: to loosen the sauce if needed

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.body: Turn the oven to 425 F. Cut the cabbage into four steaks and brush both faces with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp salt, and the pepper. Spread the cashews on one side of the sheet pan and the steaks on the rest.

steps.title: Roast
steps.body: Roast 8 minutes, then remove the cashews if they are golden. Continue roasting the cabbage until the cores are tender and the cut faces are crisp and browned, about 22 minutes more. Cook is 30 minutes.

steps.title: Blend the romesco
steps.body: Blend the cashews, roasted red peppers, garlic, smoked paprika, vinegar, remaining 3 tbsp olive oil, 1/4 tsp salt, and the water until thick and spoonable. Prep plus this blend is the 15-minute prep, overlapping the roast.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon romesco over the steaks and scatter the parsley.
